questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 59 to 61.

questions.questionText:
A single degree of freedom system has a mass, stiffness and damping of 200 kg,
20 N/m and 62 N-s/m respectively. For a forced oscillation system, if the excitation
frequency is equal to the undamped natural frequency, then the dynamic
magnification factor is ________ (rounded off to three decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 1.000 to 1.100.

questions.questionText:
The wave spectrum and the ship heave Response Amplitude Operator (RAO) are
shown in the figure. The variance of the heave motion is ______ m2 (rounded off
to three decimal places).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 0.160 to 0.180.

questions.questionText:
Consider a thin-walled closed cylindrical steel vessel with an internal pressure of
2 N/mm2. The inner diameter is 1 m, and the thickness of the wall is 10 mm. The
hoop stress is _______ N/mm2 (rounded off to one decimal place).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 99.5 to 102.5.

questions.questionText:
A propeller disc of diameter 2 m produces a thrust of 88 kN while advancing at a
speed of 5 m/s in fresh water of density 1000 kg/m3. Based on the axial momentum
theory, the propeller efficiency is _____________ % (rounded off to one decimal
place).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 70.5 to 72.5.

questions.questionText:
A ship of 5000 tonnes displacement has a rectangular tank 6 m long and 10 m wide,
half-filled with oil of relative density 0.8. The virtual reduction in the transverse
metacentric height of the ship due to free surface effect of the oil in the tank is
______ cm.
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 8 to 8.

questions.questionText:
An ocean wave of period 8 s and height 2 m is propagating in the Indian Ocean from
south to north. According to linear wave theory, for the wave to be considered as a
deep-water wave, the minimum water depth should be ______ m (rounded off to
the nearest integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 49 to 51.

questions.questionText:
Consider a gas turbine combustor with air as the working fluid. The flow enters the
device at 500 K and leaves at 1400 K with a mass flow rate of 0.1 kg/s. The changes
in kinetic energy and potential energy of the flow are neglected. Assuming
𝐶 = 0.717 kJ/kg-K and R = 0.287 kJ/kg-K, the rate of heat addition is ______ kW
𝑣
(rounded off to the nearest integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 90 to 91.

questions.questionText:
Consider a circular cylinder of diameter 0.5 m and length 2 m, rotating in clockwise
direction at a speed of 100 rpm in a flow of velocity 2 m/s. Assume the density of
the fluid as 1.225 kg/m3 and  = 3.14. By Kutta-Joukowski theorem, the lift force
on the cylinder is _______ N (rounded off to the nearest integer).
questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 20 to 21.
